description.value: TIME Family of Wines is the parent company behind two storied BC wine labels — Chronos Winery, housed in a beautifully repurposed historic movie theater in downtown Penticton, and Evolve Sparkling House, dedicated to sparkling wine and located at the gateway to the Naramata Bench. The property also includes OROLO Restaurant + Cocktail Bar, offering an elevated steakhouse experience alongside the winery's estate wines. For touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan wine country, it is a natural stop for tastings and a bottle to bring along.
